brand.name: RCE CLUB
brand.subtitle: SERVICE • CULTURE • YOUTH
brand.mission: A people-driven social movement inspired by compassion and collective civic action. Bridging resources to the vulnerable and fostering responsible young leaders.

hero.description: RCE Social Service Club unites passionate youth, students, and mentors to bring tangible grassroots change. From educating underprivileged children and organizing mega medical camps, to restoring water bodies and planting native urban forests.

about.title: Empowering Youth to Serve with
about.subtitle: Just like Kutumb (Family), RCE is founded on the philosophy that true community development begins when we treat every citizen as family.
about.storyHeading: From a Small Campus Initiative to a Statewide Movement
about.storyParagraph1: RCE Social Service Club began with a handful of passionate students who believed that youth energy should not be confined within classrooms. We witnessed rural children struggling with textbooks, seniors suffering without basic eye care, and barren public plots longing for shade.
about.storyParagraph2: Today, RCE connects thousands of students, working professionals, doctors, and community elders. We do not just hand out charity; we build self-sustaining educational ecosystems, plant trees that live for decades, and empower families with dignity.
about.checklist1: 100% of public donations go directly into on-ground drive supplies
about.checklist2: Full financial transparency with publicly published expenditure audits
about.checklist3: Active chapters across universities, colleges, and residential welfare bodies

pillars.title: Vidhya (Education)
pillars.description: Bridging the educational divide by supporting government schools, setting up smart digital labs, and conducting free weekend tutoring.

pillars.title: Prakriti (Environment)
pillars.description: Championing high-density Miyawaki urban forests, lake restoration, rainwater harvesting drives, and single-use plastic eradication.

pillars.title: Arogya (Healthcare)
pillars.description: Zero-cost screening camps for eyes, cardiac health, diabetes, and maintaining an emergency volunteer blood donation grid.

pillars.title: Seva (Relief & Nutrition)
pillars.description: Immediate flood and disaster relief packages, weekend nutritious meal distributions to attendants outside public hospitals.

projectsList.title: Vidhya Connect: Youth & Child Education
projectsList.tagline: Empowering 1,500+ rural & underprivileged students with after-school tutoring and study kits
projectsList.description: Providing quality learning kits, digital tabs, mentorship, and weekend coaching for government school students across Tamil Nadu to reduce dropout rates.

projectsList.title: Green Earth: 25,000 Miyawaki Plantation
projectsList.tagline: Restoring local biodiversity, urban green pockets, and rejuvenating dried water bodies
projectsList.description: Transforming barren public grounds, school perimeters, and lakeshores into dense native oxygen groves using the proven Miyawaki afforestation method.

projectsList.title: Arogya: Community Eye & Health Camps
projectsList.tagline: Free preventive screenings, pediatric checkups, and prescription glasses distribution
projectsList.description: Partnering with top doctors to bring mobile screening vans, free cataract diagnostics, pediatric anemia screenings, and basic medications to remote hamlets.

projectsList.title: Annapoorna: Zero-Hunger Weekend Drives
projectsList.tagline: Nutritious warm meals distributed to hospital attendants and homeless shelters
projectsList.description: Every Saturday & Sunday morning, our volunteer team prepares wholesome, hygienic meals and delivers them to government hospital attenders and night shelters.

projectsList.title: Kala Uday: Youth Talent & Sports Wing
projectsList.tagline: Fostering arts, traditional crafts, leadership workshops, and youth sports
projectsList.description: Creating a vibrant platform for youth to discover civic leadership, public speaking, folk arts, and district-level sports tournaments.

projectsList.title: Shakthi: Women Skill Development Hub
projectsList.tagline: Vocational tailoring, organic product crafting, and digital commerce skills
projectsList.description: Training rural and single mothers in certified tailoring, handloom weaving, financial literacy, and online micro-business setup to gain economic independence.

eventsList.title: Mega Tree Plantation Drive: Mission Green 5,000
eventsList.description: Join hands with 100+ fellow volunteers to plant 1,500 native saplings with tree guards and drip systems.

eventsList.title: Free Community Eye & Diabetes Screening Camp
eventsList.description: Volunteers will assist doctors with registration, token management, vision charts, and free spectacle distribution.
eventsList.leader: Dr. Ananya S. & RCE Medical Team

eventsList.title: Vidhya Connect: Book & Science Fair for Kids
eventsList.description: A fun interactive science exhibition and stationery distribution drive for 400+ middle school children.

eventsList.title: Annual Social Impact Conclave & Volunteer Awards
eventsList.description: Celebrating 5 years of relentless community service, recognizing our top youth changemakers and partners.

storiesList.name: Kavitha M.
storiesList.quote: Through Vidhya Connect's weekend mentoring, my daughter is scoring above 90% in Mathematics today. The books and tablet made all the difference.

storiesList.name: Senthil Nathan
storiesList.quote: Being a part of RCE transformed how I see my weekends. When you plant trees and feed families, you gain a sense of purpose no corporate job can give.

storiesList.name: Dr. Rajeshwar Rao
storiesList.quote: In the last 6 months alone, RCE camps screened over 2,000 seniors and identified 320 cataract cases who were given zero-cost treatment.
